description: programs.agents.claude-code.endpoints.<name> = { baseUrl; firstParty; tokenFile?; timeoutMs?; env } generates claude-<name> wrappers. claude-glm, claude-firefly, caveman-proxy (claude-cave) declare endpoints. firefly gains _CLAUDE_CODE_ASSUME_FIRST_PARTY_BASE_URL. Expose machine.sharedDomain; Aperture URL = aperture.<sharedDomain>. Drop stale devbox bucket in home-modules/policy/default.nix (import firefly.nix unconditionally).
title: Endpoint variants: one generator for claude wrappers
